dog.description_text:
Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Hamhock, who believes you can never have too many toys!

Hamhock loves a good game of fetch, especially when her favorite squeaky toy is involved! Her excitement is written all over her face with a big, happy smile. When she’s not busy playing, Hamhock enjoys spending time with people and showing off her skills during training.

Whether you’re tossing her favorite toy or spending some quality time together, Hamhock is always happy to join in the fun! Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Hamhock’s team in Pawling, New York!

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: HAMHOCK
